announcements.headline: Acquisition of Interest in Iron Ore Project
announcements.insight: UNTU acquires an interest in its Dilotiko Iron Ore Project, Kenya. This follows earlier project updates and a board appointment.

announcements.headline: Appointment of Independent Non-Executive Director
announcements.insight: UNTU appoints an independent non-executive director. This board change follows recent project updates for Tanzania and Kenya.

announcements.headline: Update on Dilotiko Iron Ore Project, Kenya
announcements.insight: Ubuntu Mining and Metals Inc. provides a project update following its October Tanzania announcement, indicating continued operational focus across its regional assets.

announcements.headline: Tanzania Update
announcements.insight: Ubuntu Mining and Metals Inc. has issued a Tanzania update. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for material developments regarding this operational region.
